meaning.en: To fight hand to hand; by extension, a head-on, no-holds-barred confrontation.
meaning.zh: 原指白刃战，比喻面对面的激烈较量。

examples.zh: 两支球队在决赛中刺刀见红，打得难解难分。
examples.en: The two teams went at each other hammer and tongs in the final.

examples.zh: 谈判进入刺刀见红的阶段，双方都不肯让步。
examples.en: The talks reached the stage of open confrontation, with neither side giving way.

examples.zh: 战士们与敌人刺刀见红，守住了阵地。
examples.en: The soldiers fought the enemy hand to hand and held the position.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; military in origin, now used figuratively for fierce rivalry.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，本为军事用语，现多比喻激烈对抗。

meaning.en: To make the final decision on a matter.
meaning.zh: 对事情作出最后决定。

examples.zh: 这个方案要由总经理拍板定案。
examples.en: The general manager will have to make the final call on this plan.

examples.zh: 会议讨论了三个小时，终于拍板定案。
examples.en: After three hours of discussion, the meeting finally settled the matter.

examples.zh: 装修的事，最后由妈妈拍板定案。
examples.en: As for the renovation, Mum had the final say.

usage.en: Predicate; business and everyday use. 拍板 alone is also common.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，职场和日常都常用，也可单说“拍板”。

natural: with a stroke of the pen

meaning.en: To sign off or write something with a bold, sweeping stroke; to decide something easily by one's authority.
meaning.zh: 形容毫不费力地写下批示或作出决定，也指文笔洒脱。

equivalents: with a stroke of the pen

examples.zh: 老板大笔一挥，批下了这笔经费。
examples.en: The boss signed off on the funding with a stroke of the pen.

examples.zh: 书法家大笔一挥，写下“和”字。
examples.en: The calligrapher wrote the character 和 in one bold sweep.

examples.zh: 他不是大笔一挥就能决定的人，每次都要反复调研。
examples.en: He is not the sort to decide things with a flick of the pen; he always researches thoroughly.

usage.en: Predicate, usually followed by the outcome. Can be mildly ironic about casual decisions.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，后接结果；有时略带讽刺，指决定随意。

meaning.en: A clear dividing line between two opposed sides, as on a Chinese chess board.
meaning.zh: 本指象棋盘中间的界线，比喻双方界限分明、互相对立。

examples.zh: 两个部门之间楚河汉界，谁也不愿越雷池一步。
examples.en: The two departments are strictly divided and neither will step over the line.

examples.zh: 他们下棋时，棋盘中央的楚河汉界摆得整整齐齐。
examples.en: When they play, the Chu–Han boundary in the middle of the board is neatly kept.

examples.zh: 夫妻之间不应该搞得楚河汉界。
examples.en: A married couple shouldn't keep everything strictly separate.

usage.en: Usually predicate or object; often describes cold, rigid separation.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、宾语，多形容界限分明、互不往来。

meaning.en: A high official in charge of a province or region (Ming and Qing dynasties: governor or governor-general).
meaning.zh: 指总管一省或数省军政大权的高级官员，如总督、巡抚。

examples.zh: 他官至封疆大吏，却始终清廉自守。
examples.en: He rose to be a provincial governor yet remained incorruptible.

examples.zh: 清代的封疆大吏权力极大。
examples.en: Qing-dynasty provincial governors wielded enormous power.

examples.zh: 这位封疆大吏上书朝廷，请求减免赋税。
examples.en: The governor petitioned the court to reduce taxes.

usage.en: Noun; historical or literary register.
usage.zh: 名词，多用于历史或书面语境。

meaning.en: A pupil who has been personally taught by a master and has learned his best skills.
meaning.zh: 指亲自受业、得到老师真传的学生。

examples.zh: 他是这位国画大师的入室弟子。
examples.en: He is a personal disciple of this master of Chinese painting.

examples.zh: 京剧名家只收了三位入室弟子。
examples.en: The opera star accepted only three personal disciples.

examples.zh: 能成为他的入室弟子，是很多人的梦想。
examples.en: Becoming his personal disciple is many people's dream.

story.en: Confucius said of Zilu: 'You has ascended the hall, but has not yet entered the inner room' (升堂矣，未入于室也). Entering the inner room came to mean reaching the deepest level of a master's teaching.
story.zh: 《论语》：“由也升堂矣，未入于室也。”后以“入室”比喻学问技艺达到精深的境界。

usage.en: Noun; used for arts, crafts and scholarship.
usage.zh: 名词，多用于艺术、技艺、学术领域。

natural: a woman dressed as a man

meaning.en: For a woman to disguise herself as a man.
meaning.zh: 女子打扮成男子的模样。

examples.zh: 花木兰女扮男装，替父从军。
examples.en: Hua Mulan disguised herself as a man and joined the army in her father's place.

examples.zh: 戏里她女扮男装，闯荡江湖。
examples.en: In the play she dresses as a man and roams the martial world.

examples.zh: 为了进学堂读书，她只好女扮男装。
examples.en: To attend school she had to dress as a man.

usage.en: Predicate; common in opera and fiction.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常见于戏曲、小说。

meaning.en: To make fire by drilling one piece of wood against another; the primitive way of making fire.
meaning.zh: 用木头摩擦生火，是远古人取火的方法。

examples.zh: 野外生存训练课上，我们学习钻木取火。
examples.en: In the wilderness survival course we learned to make fire by friction.

examples.zh: 传说燧人氏发明了钻木取火。
examples.en: Legend says Suirenshi invented the making of fire by drilling wood.

examples.zh: 他花了半个小时才钻木取火成功。
examples.en: It took him half an hour to get a fire going by friction.

story.en: Han Feizi records that in remote antiquity a sage, later identified with Suirenshi, 'drilled wood to make fire' (钻燧取火) so that people could cook food.
story.zh: 《韩非子·五蠹》载：“有圣人作，钻燧取火，以化腥臊。”传说这位圣人就是燧人氏。

date.en: end of Warring States, 3rd c. BC

usage.en: Verb-object phrase; literal in most uses.
usage.zh: 动宾结构，多取字面义。

meaning.en: Forming alliances and counter-alliances; skilful diplomatic or political manoeuvring.
meaning.zh: 战国时的外交策略，现指运用手段联合或对抗，进行政治、外交上的纵横捭阖。

examples.zh: 战国时期，各国合纵连横，局势瞬息万变。
examples.en: In the Warring States period the states shifted alliances and the situation changed by the moment.

examples.zh: 这家公司靠合纵连横，在行业里站稳了脚跟。
examples.en: The company gained its footing in the industry by clever alliance-building.

examples.zh: 国际舞台上的合纵连横从未停止。
examples.en: Alliance-building on the world stage never stops.

origin.source: 《史记·苏秦列传》《史记·张仪列传》

story.en: In the Warring States period Su Qin urged the six states to ally north–south against Qin (合纵), while Zhang Yi persuaded them to ally east–west with Qin separately (连横).
story.zh: 战国时苏秦游说六国联合抗秦，称为“合纵”；张仪游说六国分别事秦，称为“连横”。

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; historical and political contexts.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，用于历史、政治语境。

meaning.en: Only those that adapt to their environment survive.
meaning.zh: 能适应环境的生存下来，不能适应的被淘汰。

examples.zh: 商场如战场，适者生存。
examples.en: The marketplace is a battlefield: survival of the fittest.

examples.zh: 达尔文提出了物竞天择，适者生存的理论。
examples.en: Darwin put forward the theory of natural selection and survival of the fittest.

examples.zh: 在这个行业，适者生存，不学新技术就会被淘汰。
examples.en: In this industry it is survival of the fittest; those who don't learn new technology get weeded out.

story.en: Yan Fu's translation of Huxley's 'Evolution and Ethics' (1898) rendered the idea of natural selection as 'struggle for existence, natural selection, survival of the fittest'.
story.zh: 严复译述赫胥黎《天演论》，以“物竞天择，适者生存”概括进化论的思想。

usage.en: Usually a standalone slogan or a clause.
usage.zh: 常单独成句或作分句。

meaning.en: A great flood sweeping across the land; a time of great social turmoil.
meaning.zh: 大海中波涛四处奔流，比喻社会动荡不安、局势混乱。

examples.zh: 沧海横流，方显英雄本色。
examples.en: In times of great upheaval, true heroes show their mettle.

examples.zh: 乱世沧海横流，百姓流离失所。
examples.en: In those turbulent years the people were uprooted and left homeless.

examples.zh: 面对沧海横流的局势，他始终坚守原则。
examples.en: Faced with a world in turmoil, he held fast to his principles.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; literary.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，书面语。

meaning.en: To be the wealthiest person in a region.
meaning.zh: 财富居一个地区之首。

examples.zh: 他靠做茶叶生意，富甲一方。
examples.en: He became the richest man in the area through the tea trade.

examples.zh: 这位富甲一方的商人乐善好施。
examples.en: This merchant, the wealthiest in the region, was generous to the needy.

examples.zh: 昔日的小山村出了一位富甲一方的企业家。
examples.en: The little mountain village once produced a local business tycoon.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。

literal: family · wealth · ten-thousand · strings of cash

meaning.en: To own an enormous fortune.
meaning.zh: 家里财产极多，十分富有。

examples.zh: 他家财万贯，却过着十分节俭的生活。
examples.en: He is enormously wealthy, yet he lives very frugally.

examples.zh: 即使家财万贯，也买不来健康。
examples.en: Even a vast fortune cannot buy health.

examples.zh: 传说这座老宅的主人当年家财万贯。
examples.en: The owner of this old mansion is said to have been enormously rich.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。

meaning.en: To be very interested in something.
meaning.zh: 很有兴趣，兴致很浓。

examples.zh: 孩子们饶有兴趣地看着魔术师表演。
examples.en: The children watched the magician with great interest.

examples.zh: 他对考古饶有兴趣。
examples.en: He is keenly interested in archaeology.

examples.zh: 老师饶有兴趣地听完了他的想法。
examples.en: The teacher listened to his idea with real interest.

usage.en: Usually 饶有兴趣地 + verb, or predicate with 对.
usage.zh: 常作状语“饶有兴趣地……”，或作谓语。

meaning.en: To work hard with high spirits and aim for improvement.
meaning.zh: 精神振作，努力上进。

examples.zh: 同学们奋发向上，学习风气很好。
examples.en: The pupils are full of drive and the study atmosphere is excellent.

examples.zh: 这是一首催人奋发向上的歌。
examples.en: This is a song that spurs people on to improve.

examples.zh: 他一直保持着奋发向上的精神。
examples.en: He has always kept up a spirit of striving.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; often in slogans and school contexts.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，常见于口号和校园语境。

synonyms: 蒸笼里的馒头——争（蒸）口气

meaning.en: Flames leaping high into the sky.
meaning.zh: 火焰很高，照亮天空。

equivalents: a blaze lighting up the sky

examples.zh: 仓库起火，顿时火光冲天。
examples.en: The warehouse caught fire and flames shot up into the sky.

examples.zh: 远处火光冲天，消防车呼啸而去。
examples.en: A blaze lit up the distant sky as fire engines raced off.

examples.zh: 夜里山林火光冲天，村民连忙撤离。
examples.en: The forest blazed against the night sky and villagers hurried to evacuate.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。

meaning.en: Few people live there.
meaning.zh: 居住的人很少，地方荒凉。

examples.zh: 这一带人烟稀少，晚上最好不要独自出行。
examples.en: This area is sparsely populated; it is best not to go out alone at night.

examples.zh: 西北的戈壁滩人烟稀少。
examples.en: The Gobi in the north-west is thinly populated.

examples.zh: 他们在人烟稀少的山区开办了学校。
examples.en: They set up a school in a thinly populated mountain area.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。

meaning.en: To produce endless new varieties or tricks.
meaning.zh: 形容方式、样式多种多样，层出不穷。

examples.zh: 商家的促销手段花样百出。
examples.en: Shops come up with an endless variety of promotional tricks.

examples.zh: 小孩子玩起游戏来花样百出。
examples.en: Children invent all sorts of ways to play a game.

examples.zh: 这家店的甜品花样百出，每个月都有新品。
examples.en: The desserts here come in endless varieties, with something new every month.

usage.en: Predicate; can be neutral or mildly critical depending on context.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，可褒可贬。

meaning.en: The thing really did happen.
meaning.zh: 事情确实发生过，不是编造的。

examples.zh: 经调查，网上所说确有其事。
examples.en: Investigation showed that what was said online was true.

examples.zh: 网上的传闻确有其事，并非谣言。
examples.en: The rumour online is indeed true, not a hoax.

examples.zh: 记者核实后，证明此事确有其事。
examples.en: After checking, the reporter confirmed the matter was genuine.

usage.en: Predicate; used for confirming facts.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，用于证实事实。

meaning.en: To overcome one obstacle after another on the way to success.
meaning.zh: 形容一路克服重重困难，取得胜利。

examples.zh: 他过关斩将，一路杀进决赛。
examples.en: He fought his way through every round and into the final.

examples.zh: 这位新人过关斩将，终于拿到了录用通知。
examples.en: The newcomer cleared one interview after another and finally got the offer.

examples.zh: 游戏玩家要过关斩将才能见到最后的首领。
examples.en: Players must beat every level and boss before facing the final one.

story.en: In Romance of the Three Kingdoms, Guan Yu leaves Cao Cao to rejoin Liu Bei and slays six generals while passing five fortified passes (过五关斩六将).
story.zh: 《三国演义》中，关羽辞别曹操，千里寻兄，“过五关斩六将”。

date.en: late Yuan to early Ming, 14th c.

usage.en: Predicate; often for contests, interviews and games.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常用于比赛、面试、游戏。

meaning.en: To be filled with joy.
meaning.zh: 心里非常高兴。

examples.zh: 收到录取通知书，她满心欢喜。
examples.en: She was overjoyed to receive the admission letter.

examples.zh: 孩子满心欢喜地拆开礼物。
examples.en: The child opened the present with delight.

examples.zh: 他满心欢喜地回到了家乡。
examples.en: He returned home with a joyful heart.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial with 地.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，或带“地”作状语。

meaning.en: To exclaim in admiration or amazement.
meaning.zh: 不断发出赞叹声，表示惊奇。

equivalents: marvel with a click of the tongue

examples.zh: 他的画技让在场的人啧啧称奇。
examples.en: His painting skill made everyone present exclaim in wonder.

examples.zh: 游客们对这座古桥的建造工艺啧啧称奇。
examples.en: Visitors marvelled at the old bridge's construction.

examples.zh: 这个小镇的变化令老同学们啧啧称奇。
examples.en: The town's transformation amazed his old classmates.

usage.en: Predicate; 啧啧 imitates the clicking sound of admiration.
usage.zh: 多作谓语；“啧啧”是赞叹时发出的声音。

meaning.en: To give something a fine-sounding name that disguises what it really is.
meaning.zh: 给不太好的事物取一个好听的名称，含讽刺意味。

examples.zh: 他把偷懒美其名曰“劳逸结合”。
examples.en: He fancily calls his laziness 'balancing work and rest'.

examples.zh: 加班被美其名曰“奋斗精神”。
examples.en: Overtime is dressed up as 'a spirit of striving'.

examples.zh: 美其名曰为你好，其实是想控制你。
examples.en: Under the fine name of 'for your own good', he really wants to control you.

usage.en: Introduces the fine-sounding label; sarcastic.
usage.zh: 后接美名，带讽刺意味。

meaning.en: Full of vigour and energy despite old age.
meaning.zh: 形容老年人精神健旺、有活力。

examples.zh: 八十岁的老教授依然精神矍铄。
examples.en: The eighty-year-old professor is still hale and hearty.

examples.zh: 爷爷退休后天天打太极，精神矍铄。
examples.en: Grandpa does tai chi every day since retiring and is full of vim.

examples.zh: 老人精神矍铄，丝毫看不出已过九旬。
examples.en: The old man is so spry that you'd never guess he is over ninety.

story.en: The aged general Ma Yuan asked to lead a campaign, mounting his horse to show his strength; Emperor Guangwu laughed and said 'How vigorous this old man is!' (矍铄哉是翁也).
story.zh: 马援年老请战，据鞍顾盼以示可用，光武帝笑曰：“矍铄哉是翁也！”

usage.en: Predicate; only for the elderly.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，只用于老年人。

meaning.en: To have a face full of smiles.
meaning.zh: 脸上充满笑容。

examples.zh: 他笑容满面地迎接客人。
examples.en: He greeted the guests, beaming.

examples.zh: 听到好消息，她笑容满面。
examples.en: On hearing the good news she was all smiles.

examples.zh: 服务员笑容满面，让人如沐春风。
examples.en: The waiter's friendly smile put everyone at ease.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial with 地.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，或带“地”作状语。
